facts.claim: Queen Mary 2 (Cunard): Entered service 2003; 148,528 GT; 2680 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 345 m length; Ocean Liner class.
RMS Queen Mary 2 (QM2) is a British ocean liner.
Queen Mary 2 sails regular transatlantic crossings between Southampton and New York City, in addition to short cruises and an annual world voyage.

catalogSpecs.description: The only true ocean liner currently in service (delivered 2003; entered passenger service 2004).
